UMBRELLA-COORDINATION (2026-05-13): F4 and F5 from the post-PR-#103 calibration analysis are now bundled and decomposed as epic 4100-95a4-07ce-41ab (sue-tribe-skid), tagged brainstorm:complete. F6 was shipped earlier in PR #106. F7b (cross-cycle convergence file+line fingerprint matcher) does not yet have its own epic — sue-tribe-skid will emit the fingerprint surface (per its SC10) so a future F7b epic has a stable matching anchor. Governance ADR docs/adr/0013-verifier-severity-authority.md (merged via PR #122) authorizes the verifier sub-agent's severity authority as a named exception to CLAUDE.md rule 11.

When this umbrella epic enters /dso:brainstorm, the open scope is approximately: (a) the fourth fix in the calibration bundle (F7b cross-cycle convergence) — currently no epic exists, candidate for either inclusion in this umbrella's decomposition or a sibling epic; (b) any further calibration work surfaced by post-shipment telemetry from sue-tribe-skid (verifier confirm/downgrade/drop counts, minor-finding-rate canary); (c) the verifier's interaction with the future Approach 4 minor-finding ticket gate (epic bb93-c474-d065-4d06, P1, depends_on sue-tribe-skid). Do NOT re-decompose F4+F5 (already done in sue-tribe-skid). Do NOT re-author the rule-11 exception (already in ADR 0013).

Follow-on bug filed during sue-tribe-skid brainstorm: e253-f62a-1527-4319 (jumpy-bolt-scythe, P2) — orchestrator owns cross-epic-scan setup pipeline; not blocking this brainstorm but may surface again at Step 2.25.
